heading: Definitions
lead: For the purposes of this subchapter, the term—

tree.text: “conservation area” means the Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area established pursuant to section 460ccc–1 of this title;
“public lands” has the meaning stated in section 1702(e) of title 43; and
“Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

notes.text: Short TitlePub. L. 101–621, § 1, Nov. 16, 1990, 104 Stat. 3342, provided that: “This Act [enacting this subchapter] may be cited as the ‘Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area Establishment Act of 1990’.”
